content.text: The verifier's substantive review confirms the classification; the only gap is that my rationale should expressly address the failed deterministic check. Since this is a compliant finding, no redline is proposed.

input.quote: Customer agrees to provide all reasonable and necessary access, support and cooperation for Kubient to provide the Services in a timely and effective manner.
input.rationale: Compliant. The Agreement grants Kubient no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right over AP. Full-text searches for "audit", "inspect", "records" and "verif" return no hits, and a read of the entire Master Services Agreement (single section, p0000-p0074) confirms no such right exists. The only access-flavoured obligation is Section 1 (p0001), where AP agrees to provide "reasonable and necessary access, support and cooperation for Kubient to provide the Services" — a service-enablement cooperation covenant, not a right to examine AP's books, usage or systems. Direction check: this rule exists to cap a Vendor right that is adverse to us; its complete absence is more favourable to AP than the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, no system access), so there is nothing to limit and no redline is warranted. The deterministic "audit frequency limited" check fails only because there is no audit clause to carry a frequency cap — not because audits are unlimited or unannounced, so this is not walk-away territory. A "missing" finding would also be wrong: the rule is a constraint on a Vendor right, not an entitlement we need to procure. Commercially this fits the bargain, since fees flow from Kubient to AP under a revenue share with sequential liability (Section 5, p0023), leaving no AP usage or underpayment for Kubient to audit. Residual internal note: Exhibits are incorporated into the Agreement under Section 1, so if any Exhibit or amendment later introduces audit or system-access language we should require the preferred parameters at that point.
